outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented reconstruction/schematic of pre-conoidal rings and actin filaments, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented reconstruction showing cytoplasmic actin bundles and IMC, a schematic/structural rendering, not a plot.
Panel C is a micrograph (tomogram slice) with highlighted filaments, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a schematic/3D model of a lateral section showing actin populations, not a plot.
Panel E is a micrograph (average volume slice from subtomogram averaging), not a plot of averaged numerical data with individual points.
Panel F is a micrograph (tomogram slice) showing an actin filament and connecting densities, not a plot.
